title: Contract watchlist + invoice queue (scratch)
content:
Notes to self — quick triage log (afternoon sprint)

PRIORITIES
- 03/12: urgent invoice match for Vendor: SignalOps (INV-2026-045) — PO mismatch: PO 4892 vs system PO 4893. Hold payment until finance confirms.
- Contracts needing redline review this week: Vendor onboarding template (SignalOps), Partner MSA (BetaCloud) — focus on indemnity cap + data residency clause.
- Renewal alerts: SAML IdP cert rotation for AcmeCorp due 2026-04-02 — confirm renewal clause and notify AM.

TODAY'S TODO (short)
- [ ] Ping Marco for SignalOps PO confirmation (Slack thread pinned)
- [ ] Open LEGAL-412 and add initial redline comments on section 6.2
- [ ] Update GSheet invoice queue row for INV-2026-045 with hold reason
- [ ] Call BetaCloud AE (Esther) to ask for updated MSA clean copy

NOTES / CONTEXT
- SignalOps invoice hit email yesterday; CFO forwarded — likely duplicated entry from AP portal. Check AP import timestamp (sheet col H).
- BetaCloud MSA: they pushed optional arbitration language in §9; we usually push back — check playbook on Confluence: CONF-337 -> 'Vendor MSA playbook' (section: arbitration guidance).
- Renewal reminder: customer uses Private deployment, compliance team asked for KMS/HSM confirmation earlier — route to infra-eng if they ask for key rotation window.

OPEN QUESTIONS
- Can we accept SignalOps's PO 4892 if they issue refund for 4893? Who signs off? (Marco/Finance)
- For BetaCloud arbitration, how often do we escalate to legal counsel vs counter-redlining ourselves? (threshold: >$250k ARR?)

HANDOFF NOTES (if I get pulled into meeting)
- Leave SignalOps invoice row flagged "HOLD" + comment = "PO mismatch — awaiting finance confirmation. Owner: Marco".
- Put BetaCloud MSA in Drive /legal-drafts/ and share with Priya for review.
- Set AcmeCorp renewal calendar invite with subject "AcmeCorp SAML cert + renewal check" for 2026-03-25.
